name: fizzy-raycast-extension
title: Fizzy
description: Browse Fizzy boards and manage cards from Raycast.
author: toby_treacher

commands.name: boards
commands.title: Browse Boards
commands.subtitle: Fizzy
commands.description: View your Fizzy boards and open their cards.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Fizzy Base URL
preferences.description: Leave default unless using a self-hosted Fizzy instance.

preferences.name: accessToken
preferences.title: Personal Access Token
preferences.description: Create in Fizzy → Profile → API → Personal access tokens.

preferences.name: accountSlug
preferences.title: Account ID
preferences.description: The numeric account slug used in your Fizzy URL path.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
